blocks.tamil_translation: is. In this state a night will come. On that night the Qur'an will be raised up (from the hearts). Not a single verse of the Qur'an will remain on the earth. At that time, in various places, only aged men and women will remain. They will say, “We have heard the Kalimah La ilaha illallah through our forefathers. We too say it.”

blocks.text:
Silah, a student of Hazrat Hudhaifah (RA), asked, “What benefit will saying this Kalimah bring when they know nothing about fasting, Zakat and Hajj?” Hazrat Hudhaifah (RA) did not reply. He asked in this way three times. The third time, he turned to him and said, “O Silah! It is this Kalimah that will save them from Jahannam.”
(Mustadrak Hakim)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ : مَنْ قَالَ لاٰ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ نَفَعَتْهُ يَوْماً مِنْ دَهْرِهِ يُصِيبُهُ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ مَا أَصَابَهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البزار والطبراني ورواته رواة الصحيح، الترغيب:٤١٤/٢
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “For the one who has said “La ilaha illallah”, this Kalimah will certainly benefit him (bring him salvation) some day, even if before that he has to suffer the punishment for the sins he committed!”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: أَلَا أُخْبِرُكُمْ بِوَصِيَّةِ نُوحٍ ابْنَهُ قَالُوا: بَلَي قَالَ:أَوْصي نُوحٌ ابْنَهُ فَقَالَ لِابْنِهِ: يَابُنَيَّ إِنِّي أُوصِيكَ بِاثْنَتَيْنِ وَأَنْهَاكَ عَنِ اثْنَتَيْنِ أُوصِيكَ بِقَوْلِ لاٰ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ فَإِنَّهَا لَوْ وُضِعَتْ فِي كِفَّةِ الْمِيزَانِ وَوُضِعَتِ السَّموَاتُ وَاْلاَرْضُ فِي كِفَّةٍ لَرَجَحَتْ بِهِنَّ وَلَوْ كَانَتْ حَلْقَةً لَقَصَمَتْهُنَّ حَتَّي تَخْلُصَ إِلَي
